questions.concept: sizeof does not evaluate its operand

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: sizeof is evaluated at compile time and its operand expression is not executed, so k /= i+j never runs. sizeof(int) prints 4 and k stays 15.

questions.question: What is the time complexity of Merge Sort for sorting an array of size "n"?
questions.explanation: Merge sort halves the array (log n levels) and merges in O(n) per level, giving O(n log n) in all cases.

questions.question: If it is easy for competitors to enter the market, the threat of new entrants is considered:
questions.explanation: In Porter's five forces, low entry barriers mean competitors can enter easily, so the threat of new entrants is high. Low or negligible threat corresponds to high entry barriers.

questions.question: Which of the following is a primary key in a student table?
questions.explanation: Admission number is unique for every student and always present, so it is the natural primary key. Students may lack a PAN or account number, and UID is not managed by the school.

questions.question: In computer network nodes are

options.A: the computer that originates the data
options.B: the computer that routes the data
options.C: the computer that terminates the data

questions.explanation: Any device that originates, routes or terminates data is a node in a computer network, so all of these.

questions.question: What is the addressing called that is used in an instruction of the form ADD X Y?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: In ADD X Y the operands are given by their memory addresses X and Y directly in the instruction, which is absolute (direct) addressing. Indirect and index modes would need a pointer or index register.

questions.question: A collection of hyperlinked documents on the Internet forms the

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: The World Wide Web is the collection of hyperlinked documents (web pages) accessed over the Internet.

questions.question: What is the time complexity of the Divide and Conquer algorithm for finding the maximum and minimum elements in an array of size "n"?
questions.explanation: T(n) = 2T(n/2) + 2 solves to 3n/2 - 2 comparisons, which is O(n). The halving suggests O(log n) or O(n log n), but every element must still be examined.

questions.question: What is the scope of the variable declared in the user-defined function?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: A variable declared inside a function is local; it is visible only inside the { } block in which it is declared, not the whole program or main.

questions.question: Which of the following expression in SQL would calculate the square root of 16?
questions.explanation: The square root of 16 is 16^0.5, so POWER(16, 0.5) = 4. POWER(16, 2) = 256 and POWER(16, 1) = 16.

questions.question: Hierarchical addressing in the Network Layer allows for:

options.A: More efficient use of IP addresses

questions.explanation: Hierarchical (network/host) addressing allows address blocks to be allocated and aggregated efficiently, giving efficient use of IP addresses and smaller routing tables. MAC addresses are not dynamically allocated by the network layer.

questions.question: Debugging is the process of:
questions.explanation: Debugging is locating and removing defects (bugs) from software after they have been detected. Generating test cases is part of testing, which finds failures but does not fix them.

questions.question: Which of the following is an example of a digital Electronic?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: Computers, mobile phones and digital cameras all process information as discrete digital signals, so all three options are examples of digital electronics.

questions.question: A formal model of protection in an operating system provides:

options.A: A mathematical framework for analyzing resource allocation

questions.explanation: A formal protection model (e.g. the access matrix or HRU model) gives a mathematical framework for reasoning about which subjects may access which resources. It is not about UI design, memory optimisation or CPU utilisation.

questions.question: For a DFA accepting binary numbers whose decimal equivalent is divisible by 3, what are all the possible remainders?
questions.explanation: Reading a binary number modulo 3 can leave remainder 0, 1 or 2, so the DFA has three states with remainder 0 as final. Remainder 3 is impossible modulo 3.

questions.question: What is the process in which a buyer posts its interest in buying a certain quantity of items, and sellers compete for the business by submitting successively lower bids until there is only one seller left?
questions.explanation: In a reverse auction the buyer posts a requirement and sellers bid successively lower prices. In a normal auction buyers bid prices up.

questions.question: The length of an IPv6 address is:
questions.explanation: An IPv6 address is 128 bits long, written as eight groups of 16-bit hexadecimal values. 32 bits is the IPv4 address length.

questions.question:
Identify the correct output of the following code snippet:
game = "olympic2024"
print(game.index("C"))
questions.explanation: str.index() is case-sensitive and raises ValueError when the substring is not found. 'olympic2024' contains lowercase 'c' but no uppercase 'C', so an error results; -1 is what str.find() would return.

questions.question: A queue has configuration a, b, c, d. If you want to get the configuration d, c, b, a, you need a minimum of _______.

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: Delete a, b and c (3 deletions) and add them back in the order c, b, a (3 additions); the queue becomes d, c, b, a. Fewer operations cannot reverse the first three elements.

questions.question: The advantage of using an expert system development tool is:
questions.explanation: Expert system tools (shells) impose a structure, assist knowledge engineering and allow rapid prototyping, so all the listed points are advantages.

questions.question: Which of the following cannot be done with a document version?
questions.explanation: Saved document versions in Word can be opened, viewed and deleted, but a saved version itself cannot be modified; changes must be saved as a new version or file.

questions.question: In Karnaugh Maps, which of the following terms refers to a group of adjacent cells that can be combined to simplify a logic expression?
questions.explanation: In K-map simplification, adjacent 1-cells (in sizes of powers of 2) are combined into a group. A pair is only a group of exactly two cells, and block/cluster are not the standard terms.

questions.question: Program Analysis Tools are used for:

options.D: Analysing code for errors and performance bottlenecks

questions.explanation: Program analysis tools (static and dynamic analysers) examine code to find errors, standards violations and performance bottlenecks. Test case generation and reliability measurement are separate activities.

questions.question: Polymorphism is feature of
questions.explanation: Polymorphism (one interface, many forms, e.g. overloading/overriding) is a core feature of object oriented programming.

questions.question: What is DBMS?

options.A: DBMS is a collection of queries
options.D: DBMS stores, modifies and retrieves data

questions.explanation: A DBMS is software that stores, modifies and retrieves data in a database. It is not itself a language; SQL is the language used with it.
